topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes, contextualises them within the cancer biology series, and outlines the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how both stepwise genetic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations drive clonal selection and tumor initiation.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate whether malignancy arises from tissue-specific stem cells or differentiated progenitor populations using blood and intestinal cancer models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that genetic mutations require permissive inflammatory signals, external promoters, and stromal co-dependencies to achieve malignant growth.

topics.label: Methodologies for Investigating Tumor Evolution and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines experimental and computational technologies used to profile mutational timelines and spatial cellular interactions within tumors.

topics.label: Synthesis of Multi-Factorial Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the concepts of mutational accumulation, cell of origin, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental context into an overarching evolutionary model.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and provides housekeeping details about the upcoming lecture.
